edits.anchor: 4. **Viewport Fitting (NON-NEGOTIABLE)** — Every slide MUST fit exactly within 100vh
edits.proposed: 4. **Fixed Stage (NON-NEGOTIABLE)** — Every deck renders on a fixed 1920×1080 stage scaled uniformly to the viewport. Letterboxing/pillarboxing is allowed; reflowing slide content for the viewport is not. No scrolling within slides, ever. Content overflows? Split into multiple slides.
edits.why: Core Principle #4 是代理读到的第一条硬契约；若它仍写 100vh，Phase 3 的固定舞台就被它压回旧范式（r269 报告 §1 实测的失败形态）。

edits.proposed: ## Fixed Stage Rules（固定舞台不变量）
edits.why: 该标题是整块不变量的锚；不改则块内条款仍自称 viewport 规则，且与 references/upstream-frontend-slides.md:6 的「Fixed Stage Rules（固定舞台不变量）」同名断裂。

edits.anchor: - Every `.slide` must have `height: 100vh; height: 100dvh; overflow: hidden;`
edits.proposed: - Every deck wraps its slides in a fixed 1920×1080 stage: each `.slide` is authored at `width: 1920px; height: 1080px; overflow: hidden;` and the whole stage is scaled to the viewport by one `transform: scale()` (`bold-template-pack/deck-stage.js`), never reflowed
edits.why: 这一行是旧范式的可执行定义（100vh/100dvh）；它与 deck-stage.js 的 DESIGN_H_DEFAULT=1080 + scale() 直接互斥，必须与 S-01 同批，否则代理会照此写 fluid 滑页。

edits.anchor: - ALL font sizes and spacing must use `clamp(min, preferred, max)`
edits.proposed: - Slide-internal type and spacing are authoring values on the 1920×1080 draft: fixed `px` is allowed and expected; any `clamp()`/`vw`/`vh` copied from a source design is a design proportion to translate into stage coordinates, not a live responsive rule
edits.why: 包 README:70-71 明写「design.md 里的 vw/vh/clamp 要翻译成固定舞台坐标」；不改这行则 Phase 2/3 会继续产出 clamp 驱动的 fluid 版式。

edits.proposed: - Images: `max-height: 540px` (50% of the 1080 stage)
edits.why: vh 参照系在固定舞台下失效（stage 内的 100vh 是视口而非画布）；同批换为舞台像素。

edits.proposed: - No viewport-height breakpoints: the stage scales as a whole (letterbox/pillarbox) instead of reflowing content on short or narrow viewports
edits.why: 包与上游增量（references/upstream-frontend-slides.md:11「不要用响应式断点」）都禁重排；留断点等于留一条旧范式后门，且与 viewport-base.css 断点块的删除（V-05）必须同批。

edits.anchor: **When generating, read `viewport-base.css` and include its full contents in every presentation.**
edits.proposed: **When generating, read `viewport-base.css` and `bold-template-pack/README.md`, include viewport-base.css in full, and render every deck on the fixed 1920×1080 stage via `bold-template-pack/deck-stage.js` (or an equivalent inline stage scaler) — this applies even when the source template was originally viewport-fluid.**
edits.why: 这是正文唯一把「读 CSS」与「生成形态」绑在一起的一句；不在此处引入包的 Implementation Contract，代理仍只照 viewport-base.css 走 fluid（r269 实测包不可达即源于此）。

edits.proposed: 4. **After ANY modification, verify:** `.slide` is authored in 1920×1080 stage coordinates, has `overflow: hidden`, images fit the 1080 stage, and the rendered stage shows no text overflow or panel overlap at 1920×1080 and at a phone-width viewport
edits.why: Phase 0 的 Mode C 验收判据；若仍写 1280x720 + clamp，则「改完不合规」会被判为合规，迁移等于没落地。

edits.anchor: - Include the FULL contents of viewport-base.css in the `<style>` block
edits.proposed: - Include the FULL contents of viewport-base.css in the `<style>` block, and wrap every slide in the fixed 1920×1080 stage (`bold-template-pack/deck-stage.js`, or an equivalent inline scaler) instead of letting `.slide` size itself from the viewport
edits.why: Phase 3 是真正写 HTML 的步骤；此处不给 stage 包裹 = 生成物仍是 fluid，与 S-03 的正文契约自相矛盾。

edits.proposed: ⚠️ **原冲突（R268-1）已由 R269-1 消解**：本件正文原先规定 slides 必须落在 `100vh` 内（Viewport Fitting，NON-NEGOTIABLE），
edits.why: r269 登记的冲突声明必须随权威翻转同步改写，否则文件内同时存在「冲突待迁移」与「已迁移」两套说法（自相矛盾的权威）。

edits.anchor: **迁移完成前以正文的 NON-NEGOTIABLE 规则为准**
edits.proposed: ⇒ **两者对舞台尺寸的指令不再互斥**：R269-1 起正文、Phase 0/3、`viewport-base.css` 与 `html-template.md` 已同批改为固定 1920×1080 舞台；**当前权威 = 固定舞台**（`bold-template-pack/deck-stage.js` 常量 `DESIGN_W_DEFAULT = 1920` / `DESIGN_H_DEFAULT = 1080`）。
edits.why: 这句是 r269 期间的权威指针；不翻它则代理按文件读到最后仍以 100vh 为准，S-01/S-03 会被该指针反压。
